title: SQuaD: The Software Quality Dataset: A Multi-Dimensional Time-Aware Collection of Metrics for Large-Scale Empirical Research
reasoning: The paper presents a large-scale dataset of software quality metrics for empirical software engineering research. It focuses on technical aspects such as code smells, technical debt, and refactorings, and does not involve any evaluation or benchmarking of religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical components.
